```{r}
## Load necessary packages
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)


BDNF <- read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/BDNF_Neuroplastizität_Alter_CpGs_ohne_m11_und_p36_mit_verhalten_vollständig_umstrukturiert.xlsx")

TAU <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/TAU_CpGs_mit_verhalten_ohne_p61_p59_p34_p29_umstruk.xlsx"))

PSD95 <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/PSD95_CpGs_mit_verhalten_größer_umstrukturiert.xlsx"))
```

## BDNF

```{r}
# Interaction plot showing methylation levels by group and time
interaction_plot_bdnf <- ggplot(BDNF2, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = methylierung, group = Group, colour = Group)) +
  geom_line(stat = "summary", fun = mean) +
  geom_point(stat = "summary", fun = mean) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Interaction Plot of BDNF Methylation Levels by Group and Time",
    x = "Time Point",
    y = "Mean Methylation Levels"
  )

print(interaction_plot_bdnf)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bdnf-timegroup-interaction
#| fig-cap: "BDNF methylation levels (mean ± SE) by group across time points."
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate summary statistics for BDNF
summary_stats_bdnf <- BDNF2 %>%
  group_by(Zeitpunkt, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_methylierung_bdnf = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_methylierung_bdnf = sd(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Interaction plot with error bars for BDNF
interaction_plot_bdnf <- ggplot(summary_stats_bdnf, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = mean_methylierung_bdnf, group = Group, colour = Group)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_methylierung_bdnf - se_methylierung_bdnf,
      ymax = mean_methylierung_bdnf + se_methylierung_bdnf
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Interaction Plot of BDNF Methylation Levels by Group and Time",
    x = "Time Point",
    y = "Mean Methylation Levels"
  )

print(interaction_plot_bdnf)
```

```{r}
boxplot(methylierung ~ Group, data = BDNF2,
        main = "Boxplot of BDNF Methylation Levels by Group and Time",
        xlab = "Group and Time Point",
        ylab = "Methylation Levels",
        col = c("lightblue", "lightgreen"))
```
```{r}
BDNF2$time_group <- interaction(BDNF2$Zeitpunkt, BDNF2$Group, sep = " - ", drop = TRUE)

boxplot(methylierung ~ time_group, data = BDNF2,
        main = "BDNF methylation by time and group",
        xlab = "Time point - Group",
        ylab = "Methylation level",
        outline = FALSE,
        las = 2,
        col = rep(c("lightblue","lightgreen"), times = nlevels(BDNF2$Zeitpunkt)))


```

```{r}
# Interaction plot showing methylation levels by group and time
interaction_plot_tau <- ggplot(TAU2, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = methylation, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-tau-timegroup-interaction
#| fig-cap: "Tau methylation levels (mean ± SE) by group across time points."

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate summary statistics
summary_stats_tau <- TAU2 %>%
  group_by(Zeitpunkt, Gruppe) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_methylation_tau = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_methylation_tau = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
  )

# Interaction plot with error bars
interaction_plot_tau_error <- ggplot(summary_stats_tau, aes(x = as.factor(Zeitpunkt), y = mean_methylation_tau, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_methylation_tau - se_methylation_tau,
      ymax = mean_methylation_tau + se_methylation_tau
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Interaction Plot of Tau Methylation Levels by Group and Time",
    x = "Time Point",
    y = "Mean Methylation Levels"
  )

print(interaction_plot_tau_error)
```

## Plots of all genes for publication

### group differences

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactions-by-gene
#| fig-cap: "Methylation levels (mean ± SE) across time points by group for BDNF, Tau, and PSD95."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ---- BDNF ----
sum_bdnf <- BDNF2 %>%
  group_by(Zeitpunkt, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(methylierung))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_bdnf <- ggplot(sum_bdnf, aes(Zeitpunkt, mean, group = Group, colour = Group)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "BDNF", x = "Time Point", y = "Mean methylation (±SE)")

# ---- Tau ----
sum_tau <- TAU2 %>%
  group_by(Zeit, Gruppe) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(methylation))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_tau <- ggplot(sum_tau, aes(Zeit, mean, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Tau", x = "Time Point", y = "Mean methylation (±SE)")

# ---- PSD95 ----
sum_psd95 <- PSD952 %>%
  group_by(Zeitpunkt, Gruppe) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(methylation))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_psd95 <- ggplot(sum_psd95, aes(Zeitpunkt, mean, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "PSD95", x = "Time Point", y = "Mean methylation (±SE)")

(p_bdnf / p_tau / p_psd95) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

## Filtered after PCA

### Before elbow

```{r}

keep_psd95 <- c("p95", "p60", "p23")
keep_tau   <- c("m331", "m337", "m310", "m315", "m323")
keep_bdnf  <- c("m148", "m066", "m111", "m058")

PSD952_f <- PSD952 %>% filter(CpG_Position %in% keep_psd95)
TAU2_f   <- TAU2   %>% filter(CpG_position %in% keep_tau)
BDNF2_f  <- BDNF2  %>% filter(CpG_position %in% keep_bdnf)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactions-by-filtered-gene
#| fig-cap: "Methylation levels (mean ± SE) across time points by group for selected high-variance CpGs (BDNF: m148, m066, m111, m058; Tau: m331, m337, m310, m315, m323; PSD95: p95, p60, p23)."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ---- BDNF ----
sum_bdnf <- BDNF2_f %>%
  group_by(Zeitpunkt, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(methylierung))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_bdnf <- ggplot(sum_bdnf, aes(Zeitpunkt, mean, group = Group, colour = Group)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "BDNF (filtered CpGs)", x = "Time Point", y = "Mean methylation (±SE)")

# ---- Tau ----
sum_tau <- TAU2_f %>%
  group_by(Zeit, Gruppe) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(methylation))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_tau <- ggplot(sum_tau, aes(Zeit, mean, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Tau (filtered CpGs)", x = "Time Point", y = "Mean methylation (±SE)")

# ---- PSD95 ----
sum_psd95 <- PSD952_f %>%
  group_by(Zeitpunkt, Gruppe) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(methylation))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_psd95 <- ggplot(sum_psd95, aes(Zeitpunkt, mean, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "PSD95 (filtered CpGs)", x = "Time Point", y = "Mean methylation (±SE)")

(p_bdnf / p_tau / p_psd95) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```
